```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-flowchart
%%| fig-width: 8
%%| fig-cap: "Flowchart diagram of the *Case of light sensitivity* use case."
%%{init: {"flowchart": {"diagramPadding": 40}}}%%

flowchart TD

%% ===== Setup =====
P[Load packages]

%% ===== Light data stream =====
LFILE[Define light file tz coordinates]
LDATA[Import ActLumus to data]
LTRIM[Trim to diary period select Datetime and MEDI]
LQC1[Check gaps and irregulars]
LPLOT1[Plot full time series]
LPLOT2[Plot days with highest time above 250]
LPLOT3[Plot days with lowest time above 250]

LFILE --> LDATA
LDATA --> LTRIM
LTRIM --> LQC1
LTRIM --> LPLOT1
LTRIM --> LPLOT2
LTRIM --> LPLOT3

%% ===== Diary data stream =====
SEVE[Import evening diary]
SMOR[Import morning diary]
SDATES[Align evening and morning dates]
SJOIN[Join diaries into states]
SLABEL[Rename variables add next day performance fatigue]
SSUM[Summary table of diary variables]

SEVE --> SDATES
SMOR --> SDATES
SDATES --> SJOIN
SJOIN --> SLABEL
SLABEL --> SSUM

%% ===== Build sleep intervals and Brown states =====
SLEEP1[Build sleep and wake timestamps from states]
SLEEP2[Convert to intervals and Brown states]

SLABEL --> SLEEP1
SLEEP1 --> SLEEP2

%% ===== Merge light with sleep states =====
MERGE1[Add states to light data to create data_ext]
MERGE2[Add photoperiod and Brown reference columns]

LTRIM --> MERGE1
SLEEP2 --> MERGE1
MERGE1 --> MERGE2

%% ===== Brown recommendations branch =====
BROWN_PLOT[Plot Brown states and compliance over weeks]
BROWN_TAB[Table of Brown compliance and duration]

MERGE2 --> BROWN_PLOT
MERGE2 --> BROWN_TAB

%% ===== Sleep wake cycles and metrics =====
SW1[Create sleep wake cycles data_sw]
SWPLOT[Heatmap doubleplot of sleep timing]
SWDUR[Durations of sleep wake cycles]
SWFILTER[Remove partial cycles 01 and 20]

MERGE2 --> SW1
SW1 --> SWPLOT
SW1 --> SWDUR
SW1 --> SWFILTER

METRICS[Summarize dose and time above 250 per cycle to summaries_sw]
JOINDIARY[Join summaries_sw with states by date]

SWFILTER --> METRICS
METRICS --> JOINDIARY
SLABEL --> JOINDIARY

TABLE[Formatted overview table of light metrics and questionnaire data]
JOINDIARY --> TABLE

%% ===== Correlation plots =====
CORFUNC[Define correlation_plot helper]
CORPLOT[Correlation plots between light metrics and self report]

JOINDIARY --> CORFUNC
CORFUNC --> CORPLOT
```
